units: residual_* and tol are USDT-equivalent: USD-denominated NAV terms divided by the USDT valuation rate p1 (index × (1 − 1e-4)); tol = max(2.0, 0.5e-4 × N0 / p0)

tracks.INDEPENDENT: INDEPENDENT: valuation from the public index only (1m klines; band = [low, high] of the minute containing nav_ts, × (1 − buffer)); independent of wallet/income flows. Conditional on the declared buffers (USDT 1e-4, BNB 0.05) being constant over 08-01..09-19.
tracks.CONDITIONAL_EXACT_RATE: CONDITIONAL_EXACT_RATE: conditional on income-flow completeness; cannot certify wallet flows or valuation. The rate is reconstructed from the same income flows under test, so a missing wallet flow cancels out.

rules.independent_band: [low, high] of the 1m index kline whose minute contains nav_ts, × (1 − buffer); residual interval = exact min/max over the 16 corners of (p0, p1, b0, b1) (residual is multilinear in 1/p0, 1/p1, b0, b1)
rules.independent_verdict: CONSISTENT iff interval ∩ [−tol, +tol] ≠ ∅ and no quantity failures and no non-USDT/BNB assets
rules.conditional_track: only where BNB = 0 at both ends; never falls back to kline; never merged with INDEPENDENT

exact_rate_band_coverage.label: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (not a verdict): the exact rate is itself conditional on income-flow completeness
exact_rate_band_coverage.precision_note: index klines are printed to 8 decimals (≈0.005–0.01 ppm at USDTUSD ≈ 1); inside/outside flags are strict (no rounding allowance)

INDEPENDENT.label: INDEPENDENT: valuation from the public index only (1m klines; band = [low, high] of the minute containing nav_ts, × (1 − buffer)); independent of wallet/income flows. Conditional on the declared buffers (USDT 1e-4, BNB 0.05) being constant over 08-01..09-19.

detection_power.rule: a missing wallet flow d shifts the residual by −d; the window stays CONSISTENT iff d ∈ [lo − tol, hi + tol]

CONDITIONAL_EXACT_RATE.label: CONDITIONAL_EXACT_RATE: conditional on income-flow completeness; cannot certify wallet flows or valuation. The rate is reconstructed from the same income flows under test, so a missing wallet flow cancels out.

legacy_v2_mixed_rule_reconciliation_only.rule: v2 headline: exact-rate residual where available, else kline point residual; NOT a verdict (merges the two tracks)
